scientific_conclusion: The exact Stage-82 opposite-sector pair maps reconstruct to machine precision. Each pair retains more than 99.91% of the two constituent sector cell-divergence magnitude, so opposite-sector cancellation remains unsupported. Instead, the pair maps are strongly conservative-cancellation dominated: rowwise signed retention is at most 4.75e-17, outer x quarters contain at least 85.60% of the absolute cell-divergence magnitude, side-wall eighths contain about 71%, and the face-to-cell magnitude ratio is at most 0.08829. The next justified step is therefore a frozen wall-normal sign-lobe geometry audit, not a solver experiment or parameter change.
positive_findings: The two fixed opposite-sector pair maps reconstruct all four retained Stage-82 sector maps to machine precision without rebucketing or a new solver state.
Both pair maps preserve essentially all constituent sector cell-divergence magnitude and show strong outer-x and side-wall localization.
Global, rowwise, columnwise, side-wall, and face-to-cell cancellation are quantified on the frozen pair maps.
negative_findings: The near-zero rowwise signed remainder is strongly conservative-cancellation dominated and is not an adjoint sensitivity or a prediction of q_av response.
Strong rowwise or side-wall structure does not constitute physical validation and does not by itself identify a numerical error mechanism.
Opposite-sector cancellation is not supported because both fixed sector pairs retain more than 99.9% of their constituent cell-divergence magnitude.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and is not extended across Knudsen number.
No physical, collision, correction-floor, source-relaxation, transport, wall, normalization, or velocity-quadrature parameter was retuned, and no cavity solver was rerun.

next_stage.name: Wall-Normal Sign-Lobe Geometry Audit
next_stage.scope: Using only the exact checksum-verified Stage-83 pair face and cell maps, verify conservative face-to-cell telescoping and resolve the wall-normal x sign-lobe geometry. Quantify whether the near-zero rowwise remainder is concentrated in the first wall-normal interior cells or distributed across x, and distinguish compact inherited-sign lobes from broad compensating structure. Do not rerun the cavity solver, retune any physical or numerical parameter, rehabilitate the failed MUSCL endpoint, extend across Knudsen number, or make a validation or q_av-sensitivity claim.
